slots.title: Coaches arrive at the school
slots.blurb: Coaches arrive at West Henderson High School, 3600 Hayward Road, Hendersonville, NC.

slots.title: Load the coaches and depart for Chattanooga
slots.blurb: Chattanooga is the city that raised the Empress of the Blues, named a Glenn Miller standard, and hides a waterfall a thousand feet inside a mountain.

slots.title: Lunch stop on the way
slots.blurb: A quick stop for lunch on the go.
slots.note: At own cost, or can be added.

slots.title: Rock City Gardens
slots.blurb: 4,100 feet of trail winding through, under and between the boulders on top of Lookout Mountain, ending at Lover's Leap where, on a clear day, they will tell you that you are looking at seven states at once.

slots.title: Lookout Mountain Incline Railway
slots.blurb: A mile straight up the face of Lookout Mountain, steepening until the grade hits 72.7 percent.

slots.title: Group dinner
slots.blurb: Dinner at the 1909 terminal station, now a hotel and dining district built inside the old train shed.

slots.title: Ruby Falls
slots.blurb: A 145-foot waterfall a thousand feet inside Lookout Mountain, found by accident in 1928 by a man drilling an elevator shaft.
slots.note: The supplier says the first ride is 09:00. This printed time cannot be met as written.

slots.title: Point Park and the overlook
slots.blurb: The 1863 Battle Above the Clouds site, looking 1,700 feet down at Moccasin Bend.

slots.title: Lunch downtown
slots.note: At own cost, or can be added.

slots.title: Bessie Smith Cultural Center
slots.blurb: The Empress of the Blues was born nine blocks away and sang on street corners for pocket change.

slots.title: High Point Climbing and Fitness
slots.blurb: The wall is bolted to the outside of the building and hangs out over the sidewalk; auto-belays mean you are climbing within ten minutes.

slots.title: Group dinner on the North Shore
slots.blurb: A ten-minute walk across the Walnut Street Bridge, a third of a mile of open deck suspended over the Tennessee River.
ops_steps: Leave the coaches downtown; the group crosses on foot
Return to the hotel after dinner

slots.title: Breakfast at the hotel
slots.note: Dress for the concert, or bring concert attire along.

slots.title: Tennessee Aquarium
slots.blurb: Two buildings on the riverfront: River Journey follows the water from an Appalachian forest to the Gulf, Ocean Journey has sharks, penguins and a stingray touch tank.

slots.title: Lunch at the aquarium plaza
slots.note: At own cost, or can be added.

slots.title: Cirque de la Symphonie
slots.blurb: The symphony plays a full orchestral programme while aerialists, contortionists, jugglers and strongmen perform to it live, on the stage and in the air above it. Every catch is timed to the downbeat.

slots.title: Optional minor-league baseball
slots.note: If the team is at home. Cost can be added.

slots.title: Check out and load the coaches
slots.note: This operational step is printed on the factual iteration and is absent from the narrative iteration.

slots.title: Southern Belle riverboat
slots.blurb: Ninety minutes on the Tennessee, narrated from the wheelhouse, past Maclellan Island and around Moccasin Bend.

slots.title: Ross's Landing and the Passage
slots.blurb: Where the city began, and one of the 1838 departure points for the forced removal of the Cherokee people. The Passage marks it with seven ceramic discs for the seven Cherokee clans.

slots.title: Lunch locally, then depart for home
slots.note: Lunch at own cost, or can be added.

exclusions.text: Cancellation protection is recommended and can be added at registration. The Cancel For Any Reason benefit covers 75% of the nonrefundable trip cost and cancellation must be received in writing 72 hours prior to departure. Pricing is based on the per person package cost of the trip.

Pricing is subject to availability and may increase until time of booking. The price is subject to change based on your final number of paying participants. In the event of rising fuel costs it may be necessary to add fuel surcharges to the cost of any motor coach or airline charter.
exclusions.note: The operator's own terms make every headcount change a legitimate re-quote. The problem is not that re-quotes happen; it is that each one costs an afternoon.
